ErrorCode.description:
Canonical error codes for /v1/forecast and adjacent endpoints.

Snake_case strings; one source of truth so callers can compare against a
fixed set instead of guessing at the wire shape. Adding a new failure
mode means adding it here and using it at the construction site.

Return ``costNanoUsd`` for each ``requestId`` owned by the caller.

Called by HuggingFace's reconciliation system every minute in batches of up
to 10,000 request IDs. Each requested ID is echoed back in the response,
with ``costNanoUsd: 0`` if the caller does not own the request or if it
does not exist, to avoid leaking information about other tenants.
